title: Raw Salmon Avocado Uramaki
description: A rice-outside roll with silky raw salmon, creamy avocado, cucumber and sesame.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

ingredients.name: Salmon intended for raw consumption, unless cooked

steps: Cut salmon into slender sashimi-safe strips, then cut avocado and cucumber into similar batons. Pat cucumber dry.
Cover a sushi mat with food-safe wrap. Spread seasoned rice across half a nori sheet, scatter sesame and flip rice-side-down.
Arrange salmon, avocado and cucumber over exposed nori; add a small amount of Kewpie if desired.
Roll tightly, press to shape, and cut into eight pieces with a damp knife.
notes: Keep raw salmon refrigerated until the moment of assembly.
Baseline makes approximately six light servings. Ingredient quantities can be scaled independently.
Prepare and season sushi rice using its separate recipe.
For uncooked salmon, use a reputable raw-consumption supplier, keep chilled and assemble promptly.
